d: Company Description Delight Events is a Kuwait-based event planning company that has been creating memorable experiences since 2019. The team specializes in designing and executing a wide range of events, including weddings, corporate functions, and private gatherings. With a strong focus on creativity and attention to detail, Delight Events works closely with clients to bring their visions to life and consistently exceed expectations. The company is driven by a commitment to excellence and aims to deliver events that inspire joy and leave a lasting impression. Professionals joining Delight Events become part of a collaborative team dedicated to high-quality service and customer satisfaction.

Role Description The Sales Business Development Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Kuwait City. This position is responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, generating qualified leads, and building a strong pipeline of potential clients for Delight Events. The role involves conducting market research, networking, and meeting with prospective clients to understand their event needs and present suitable solutions. The Executive will manage key accounts, maintain long-term client relationships, and collaborate with the events team to ensure proposals and contracts align with client expectations. Daily activities include preparing sales presentations, following up on inquiries, negotiating terms, and contributing to revenue targets while upholding the company’s service standards.
q: Strong skills in New Business Development and Lead Generation, with the ability to identify opportunities and build a sustainable client pipeline.
Business and Account Management skills, including managing client relationships, handling contracts, and supporting repeat and referral business.
Excellent Communication skills, with the ability to present ideas clearly, negotiate effectively, and engage with clients and internal teams.
Previous experience in sales, business development, or client-facing roles, preferably in events, hospitality, or related industries.
Ability to work on-site in Kuwait City, manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, and meet sales targets in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency in basic business tools (e.g., CRM systems, MS Office) and comfort with preparing proposals and presentations.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
Fluency in English is required; knowledge of Arabic is an advantage.

d: Lean is hiring a Talent Acquisition Manager to operate in a player-coach role: leading a small talent team while owning GTM & Business hiring. You'll manage and develop the team, drive hiring quality and speed, and act as a strategic partner to leadership. If you're someone who raises the bar on every hire, builds systems that outlast you, and takes pride in the caliber of people joining a company, this role is for you.

Lean is the leading financial infrastructure provider in the Middle East. We power some of the region's largest companies with APIs that enable payments, account verification, financial data access, and other critical financial infrastructure.

What started as the region's pioneering Open Banking platform and quickly became the de facto leader in account aggregation and payment initiation in the region is now becoming something bigger: a multi-product infrastructure company powering payments, data, and lending across MENA.

We've processed billions of dollars in transactions. We're trusted by 450+ clients - from Binance and Careem to Etisalat - and backed by General Catalyst, Sequoia, and Shorooq. Our $67.5M Series B was just the beginning. We're expanding into new markets, opening offices, acquiring businesses, and building capabilities that didn't exist here before.
q: Talent experience at a VC firm at startup/scale-up phase, with at least 1 year in a people management capacity
A track record of closing senior GTM and leadership hires.
Ability to manage up. You can advise leadership on org design and comp, and you push back with data.
Structured assessment habits: scorecards, calibrated loops, evidence over instinct.
Excellent process management and ATS proficiency (Ashby experience is a plus), with high attention to detail
Prior experience hiring across UAE and/or KSA markets
Strong command of hiring metrics and reporting
You know how to build a company's presence and reputation in the talent market
Experience with Emiratization and/or Saudization programmes

NB. While we think the above experience could be important, we’re keen to hear from people that believe they have valuable experience to bring to the role. If you identify with the team and mission, but not all of our requirements, then please still apply!!
